observation.command: PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select count(*) from users"; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select email, verified_at is not null as verified from users where email like '%@consul.dev' order by email limit 12"; echo "=== users columns ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select string_agg(column_name, ', ') from information_schema.columns where table_name='users'"; echo "=== admin-like role tables ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public' and table_name ilike '%admin%'"
